parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$P(X<54.8)=P\!\left(Z<\frac{54.8-55.6}{1.2}\right)$ [M1] Use $\pm$ standardisation with $54.8$, $55.6$ and $1.2$; condone $1.2^2$, $\sqrt{1.2}$ or continuity correction $54.75$/$54.85$.
$P(Z<-0.6667)=1-0.7477$ [M1] Appropriate normal area from the final process; must be a probability.
$0.2523$ [A1] Accept $0.252\leq p\leq0.2525$. If A0, SC B1 for this range.
$400(0.2523)=100.92$, so $100$ or $101$ [B1 FT] FT their 4SF-or-better probability from a normal calculation; must be a single integer.
Total: 4

$P(-1/2<Z<1/2)=\Phi(1/2)-\Phi(-1/2)$ [M1] Both $1/2$ and $-1/2$ seen as z-values, or appropriate use of either; no other z-values in part.
$2\Phi(1/2)-1=2(0.6915)-1$ [M1] Calculate the appropriate area from stated phis of z-values which are $\pm$ the same number.
$0.383$ [A1] Accept $0.3829\leq p\leq0.383$. If A0, SC B1 for this range.
Total: 3
